source_policy: public official/authoritative web only; exact-site conclusions fail closed

sources.claim: CIL guidance explains charging, relief/exemptions, liability, collection, spending and monitoring.
sources.guard: general CIL guidance does not establish an exact site's charging schedule, rate, relief or liability.

sources.status: current guidance with paragraph-level revision dates
sources.claim: Planning obligations must satisfy necessity, direct relationship and fair/reasonable scale-and-kind tests.
sources.guard: general s106 guidance does not prove an exact site's obligation or amount.

sources.claim: Water companies must prepare and maintain WRMPs for secure supply and environmental protection.
sources.guard: WRMP evidence is strategic and does not prove exact-site water capacity or planning acceptability.

sources.claim: National SuDS standards support design, maintenance and operation of surface-water drainage systems.
sources.guard: standards do not by themselves approve a site's drainage strategy.

sources.claim: LPAs use standing advice to review flood-risk assessments and SuDS information and decide when EA consultation is needed.
sources.guard: standing advice is not a site-specific FRA result.

sources.claim: From 6 August 2026 BNG does not apply to planning applications for developments of 0.2 hectares or below.
sources.guard: future-effective exemption requires exact application date and development area evidence.

sources.claim: LPAs must check BNG application information where the biodiversity gain condition applies.
sources.guard: guidance does not prove a specific application is subject to or exempt from BNG.

sources.claim: Guidance covers what may count toward BNG and notes NSIP BNG from 2 November 2026.
sources.guard: future NSIP commencement and scheme-counting rules require exact development evidence.

sources.claim: BNG legal agreements may secure on-site or off-site gains and apply to NSIPs from 2 November 2026.
sources.guard: general legal-agreement guidance does not prove an agreement exists for a parcel.

sources.claim: NMDC gives detailed guidance for producing design codes and expands on the National Design Guide.
sources.guard: NMDC is guidance and not a site-specific permission or local adopted code.

sources.claim: The page is a consultation on draft consolidated Design and Placemaking PPG.
sources.guard: draft consultation material must not be treated as adopted current guidance.

sources.claim: Index provides 2026 chief planning officer letters and earlier letters.
sources.guard: letter-level applicability and legal/policy status must be checked before exact-site use.

sources.claim: Guidance describes readiness for the new plan-making system and explicitly says it will be reviewed as implementation/policy are confirmed.
sources.guard: draft readiness guidance is not an adopted local plan.

sources.claim: Guidance explains when environmental permits are needed for liquid effluent/waste-water discharges and standard/bespoke routes.
sources.guard: environmental permit status is separate from planning permission.

sources.claim: SCI consultation seeks views on scheme design for electricity network capacity at selected motorway service areas.
sources.guard: consultation is not an enacted site designation or planning permission.

sources.claim: Guidance supports local administration of Electric Vehicle Charging Point Relief.
sources.guard: business-rate relief is not planning consent.

sources.claim: Dataset reports 94,023 tree preservation zones from 79 providers and says some MHCLG-created data remains pending authoritative replacement.
sources.guard: partial coverage and geometry do not prove absence/presence of an exact legal TPO without authority evidence.

sources.claim: Dataset says flood zones are indicators and cannot tell whether a location will definitely flood or severity.
sources.guard: stale collector and indicative flood-zone data require current site-specific flood evidence.

sources.claim: Dataset reports brownfield-register information from authoritative sources.
sources.guard: brownfield-register inclusion/suitability does not equal planning permission or exact deliverability.
